content: Metronome/tempo-progression sources converge on small-increment speed building: raise tempo ~2-5 BPM only after playing a passage cleanly 2-3 times in a row, drop back 2 BPM on a miss, isolate short passages (<=20 measures, sometimes 1 measure), and deliberately practice below target tempo (50-55%) for timing/relaxation before ramping up — mirrors classic 'speed mechanics' method-book progression schemes.
